title: Starry Night & Sunflowers
welcome_lead: Van Gogh's swirling skies and golden blooms.
meta_desc: KS3 famous artworks: Van Gogh's Starry Night and Sunflowers.
final_note: Van Gogh painted feelings with thick, swirling strokes.

concepts.def: Style after Impressionism with stronger feeling.
Thick paint that stands off the canvas.

walkthroughs.body_html: Starry Night (1889) shows a wild swirling sky over a calm village. Van Gogh painted it from memory while staying in a mental hospital in Saint-Remy, France.
The Sunflowers series (1888) glows with yellow paint laid on thickly using impasto. Van Gogh painted them to welcome his friend Paul Gauguin to Arles.
Van Gogh belongs to Post-Impressionism. He kept Impressionism's bright colour but added strong outlines and emotional brushwork. He sold few paintings in his life — now they sell for millions.
